description: This Java class defines a Spring component for configuring SAML2 relying party metadata, including entity ID, SSO URL, single logout settings, and certificate/key handling.

classes.name: RelyingPartyMetadata
classes.description: Spring component for configuring SAML2 relying party registration with metadata, credentials, and logout settings.

classes.name: RelyingPartyMetadata.SingleLogout
classes.description: Inner class representing SAML2 single logout configuration including binding, location, and response location.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Builds and returns a RelyingPartyRegistration object configured with entity ID, SSO URL, logout settings, and credentials.

methods.name: setEntityId
methods.description: Sets the entity ID for the relying party.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Loads an X.509 certificate from a resource path.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the RSA private key used for signing.

methods.name: getBinding
methods.description: Returns the SAML2 message binding used for logout.

methods.name: setBinding
methods.description: Sets the SAML2 message binding for logout.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the logout service location URL.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the logout service location URL.

methods.name: getResponseLocation
methods.description: Returns the response location URL for logout.

methods.name: setResponseLocation
methods.description: Sets the response location URL for logout.
